# JSP-000737: Verified Lean formalization of the known Erdős–Rosenfeld fourth-root divisor bound

## English

**Draft observation candidate; awards-repository review is pending.** This is a self-submission of an AI-assisted formalization from the public SphereDonout/lean-proofs repository. The title describes the project's reported Lean verification. It does not represent a completed verification decision by this awards repository, an award, or confirmation of prize eligibility. The submitting contributor is represented by the unconfirmed placeholder `RECIPIENT-JSP-000737-LEAN-A`.

Related submission discussion: [intake issue #444](https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/issues/444).

### Mathematical scope and attribution

The mathematical proof is credited to **P. Erdős and M. Rosenfeld**, *The factor-difference set of integers*, Acta Arithmetica 79 (1997), 353–359, specifically Proposition 4.1 and its divisor-count consequence on page 356. See the [published article](https://doi.org/10.4064/aa-79-4-353-359) and [primary paper PDF](https://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/aa/aa79/aa7944.pdf).

The exported theorem `JSP737.erdos_rosenfeld_bound` proves that, for every real `C > 0`, all sufficiently large natural numbers `n` have at most `1 + C²` positive divisors in the **closed** interval `[√n, √n + C n^(1/4)]`. The project also proves the bound pointwise for every positive `n` and every `C ≥ 0`. Its extension to `n = 0` uses Mathlib's convention `Nat.divisors 0 = ∅`.

This is a known partial result associated with [JSP-000737](https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/blob/main/problems/catalog-0701-0800.md#JSP-000737) and [Erdős Problem 886](https://www.erdosproblems.com/886). The full problem asks for a bound depending only on `ε` for divisors in `(√n, √n + n^(1/2 − ε))`, for every `ε > 0` and all sufficiently large `n`. This formalization does not settle the missing range `0 < ε < 1/4`. Consequently, the parent problem's resolution remains unclaimed and `problem.resolved` is `null`.

The corresponding known-result statement is the `rosenfeld_bound` variant in [Formal Conjectures at revision 40e7c98697de6f66b8cbdbf641749ab39ed9c152](https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/blob/40e7c98697de6f66b8cbdbf641749ab39ed9c152/FormalConjectures/ErdosProblems/886.lean). Admitted upstream theorems are not imported into the proof. A previously published [AlphaProof proof for the special case C = 1](https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/1942#discussion_r2749752508) is related prior formalization work; this submission concerns general `C` and makes no universal priority claim.

### Pinned source and reproduction evidence

- Repository: [SphereDonout/lean-proofs](https://github.com/SphereDonout/lean-proofs).
- Fixed source commit: `b07478dcea77b452e94e9811048516bfbf3ff137`.
- Project: [jsp-000737 at the fixed commit](https://github.com/SphereDonout/lean-proofs/tree/b07478dcea77b452e94e9811048516bfbf3ff137/jsp-000737).
- Toolchain: Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.33.1`.
- Mathlib revision: `0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474`; the project includes `lake-manifest.json` with dependency revisions.
- [Build instructions](https://github.com/SphereDonout/lean-proofs/blob/b07478dcea77b452e94e9811048516bfbf3ff137/jsp-000737/README.md), [verification report](https://github.com/SphereDonout/lean-proofs/blob/b07478dcea77b452e94e9811048516bfbf3ff137/jsp-000737/docs/verification-report.md), and [statement-scope audit](https://github.com/SphereDonout/lean-proofs/blob/b07478dcea77b452e94e9811048516bfbf3ff137/jsp-000737/docs/scope-audit.md).

The submitter-provided evidence reports a clean project rebuild with warnings treated as errors and 17 transitive axiom audits permitting only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. It includes a separate AI statement review and compiled boundary checks. Dependency caches were reused; these are not claims of a build from independently rebuilt dependency sources, a second independent proof checker, or human review.
